summary: Full diagnosis, root cause analysis, and resolution of the LinkedIn 401 INVALID_ACCESS_TOKEN failure in GitHub Actions.

verified_run.topic: Enterprise AI adoption mistakes to avoid

what_assistant_did.action: Created HANDOFF.md, handoff.json, and linkedin_auth_runbook.md to completely map out architecture, credentials, and API requirements without secret leakage.
Diagnosed that /v2/me is deprecated for modern OpenID Connect apps (returns 401 INVALID_ACCESS_TOKEN) and pointed the pipeline to /v2/userinfo to resolve author URN.
Verified and synchronized the REST API headers to LinkedIn-Version: 202606 and X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0 to prevent 426 Upgrade Required errors.
Updated LinkedInConnector in linkedin_agents.py to automatically sanitize tokens and URNs (stripping trailing whitespace, line breaks, and stray enclosing quotes).
Elevated LinkedIn API error response logging from suppressed logger.debug to logger.error so that GitHub Actions logs always reveal the exact API error payload.
Built and pushed verify_linkedin_token.py (zero dependencies, standard library urllib) to allow instant CLI testing of tokens, URN extraction, and post permission checks.
Patched .git/hooks/pre-commit to use git pull --rebase --autostash origin main to prevent local commit failures when working trees have staged files.

what_user_hakan_did.action: Selected the correct developer app: 'github 1' (discarded 'hakan growth bot' which lacked OpenID Connect and had unverified company page association).
Navigated to LinkedIn Developer Token Generator (https://www.linkedin.com/developers/tools/oauth/token-generator).
Checked all 4 required scopes: openid, profile, email, w_member_social.
Authorized the application with personal LinkedIn account and minted a clean 60-day OAuth Bearer token (AQW-...).
Updated GitHub Repository Secrets (LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN and LINKEDIN_PERSON_URN) under repository settings.
Triggered manual workflow_dispatch for 'LinkedIn Growth Bot' and confirmed 100% green run (Run #676).

auth_endpoints.deprecated_endpoint: https://api.linkedin.com/v2/me (do NOT use; always fails with 401 on OIDC tokens)

token_lifecycle.expiry_action: When token expires after 60 days, operator re-mints via Token Generator and updates GitHub Secret LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN.
